title: pm-dispatch: project forms — lane project and director project, lanes read from the seat post's 🟢 line, the maintainer's one-sentence assignment, takeover of a walled account, mailbox PRs, generated roster board (maintainer's word 2026-10-23)
body:
Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task, the maintainer's words quoted verbatim. Filed from the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (account `os-elon-musk`) by the research thread 车队机制迁往 Projects on the maintainer's word there. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane self-applied under exception 二; grade suggested p2; triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287), in one PR on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (Tier S) plus ratchet ceiling rows in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. Card thread at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Builds on #25379 (PR #25385 — still an OPEN draft at 12:55Z, waiting for the maintainer's naming; ⛔ correction of the first filing, which called it landed): that card gives the project-run seat its stub; this one gives the project layer itself. Land this PR after #25385, merging `main` once it is in.
## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, project thread 车队机制迁往 Projects, verbatim)

> 我的账户清单不固定的， 20x 周流量用完了，我就会换另外一个账户。 (06:27Z)
> 具体的分配应该是我人工制定的。 (06:27Z)
> 元数据项目应该各自分诊，但是决裁可以统一报总监。 (06:32Z)
> 管理者不是 bill 是 hotlong / 或者你不要强调是谁 (11:45Z, 11:46Z)
> 全项目并发上限 6 (11:46Z)
> 分诊不忙不如留给总监管 (12:08Z)
> 如果我同意这一整套机制，相关的 skills 是不是都要修改，文件应该落在仓库中 (12:10Z)
> 你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务，跟踪落地 (12:13Z)

> 为什么我们需要区分项目类型？任何一个项目中都可以召唤总监啊，任何一个项目中也可以召唤分诊 (12:25Z — **amendment**: there is ONE project form; 总监席 and 分诊席 are seats like any other, summoned by the maintainer's sentence in whichever project he names. The only invariant is on the account, already in the protocol: 「批准账号永不跑席位」.)
> 我直接写 pm-dispatch 总监，pm-dispatch ui，  pm-dispatch 分诊，这种应该都可以吧？ 或者 fleet 总监 ？fleet ui ？ (12:27Z — **amendment**: the project instruction IS the summon: 「pm-dispatch <席位…>」.)

The research memo these cards implement: https://claude.ai/artifact/VFTHWcmKkzbah17UM8KRqm (sections 6, 10–13; private to the maintainer's account).

## What was measured (this project, 2026-10-22 14:22Z – 10-23 12:10Z)

- A Claude Code project belongs to one account. The maintainer runs many 20x accounts and switches when a week's quota is spent, so no account is permanent and no lane→account table can be written down. What survives a switch is only what is on GitHub.
- Which account holds a lane is already a GitHub fact: the seat post's 🟢 line (`seat-post-protocol.md`: 「🟢 后写召唤账号」); the three seats this project holds carry 「由 os-elon-musk 账户的项目负责」.
- A walled account writes nothing, so a takeover cannot wait for its wall note. The protocol already has the pieces: 维护者强制接管令 (`seat-lifecycle.md`), 「认领人不可达(token 耗尽) ⇒ 接管」 (`execution-duties.md` L82), `Release:` + `Resume-from: BRANCH@SHA` (SKILL.md L317).
- Cross-account messages: a thread subscribed to a PR is woken by comments on it. Measured on #25392 (an empty-commit draft PR): a relay comment woke the subscribed thread 70 s after posting with the verbatim body (06:41Z); a comment by `os-bill` woke it within 4 s (11:44:30Z, comment 6364106224). Issue comments wake nothing. The subscription also applies the drive-to-green rules to the PR, and `Check Changeset` reddened on the empty diff.
- Repo skills and `settings.json` hooks are not surfaced in a project rooted at the parent of several checkouts (`ListSkills` empty; `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` unset in three readings); each repo's `CLAUDE.md` does load. So a project's instructions can be one sentence pointing at pm-dispatch, and nothing may rely on the SessionStart hook from #25380 in that layout.
- Protocol rule 5 (`cross-repo-coordination.md`): one board, no second tracker — any roster must be a generated view.

## Wanted

A new reference `references/project-forms.md`, pointed at from SKILL.md's reference table, defining the project layer above seats:

1. **One project form (amended 12:25Z).** A 车队项目 is any Claude Code project on any account whose instructions point at pm-dispatch. What it does is decided entirely by which seats it holds: lane seats (cards, PRs, cross-account review), the 总监席 (decision inbox + ruling batches drafted for the maintainer, releases, daily digest, roster board) and the 分诊席 (labels and audit comments only) are all seats, summoned by the maintainer's sentence in whichever project he names. The one invariant is on the **account**, not the project, and is already protocol: 「批准账号永不跑席位」 — the account that holds Tier H human approval sits no execution seat; the reference restates it in one line and adds nothing. Logins appear in rulings only as evidence of a past event.
2. **Project instructions are one line, and that line is the summon (amended 12:27Z)**: 「pm-dispatch <席位> [<席位>…]」, e.g. 「pm-dispatch 总监」, 「pm-dispatch ui」, 「pm-dispatch 分诊」, 「pm-dispatch ui skills」. The first token is the skill directory's own name (⛔ not `fleet`, which already names the bot and the relay); the seat tokens accept the Chinese name or the lane charter file name — the reference carries the one-line mapping (总监 = `lanes/director.md`, 分诊 = `lanes/triage.md`, ui/skills/devx/cli/engine/services/spec/hotcrm as their file names). A lane with several seat posts: the coordinator takes the one whose 🟢 line names this account, else the vacant one, else asks once. Everything else lives in this reference. ⛔ No template is pasted into a project; ⛔ no account-level skill copy.
3. **Seats are read, not configured.** A project's seats (lane, 总监, 分诊) = the seat posts whose 🟢 line names this account. Before any dispatch the coordinator reads the seat posts; none ⇒ the project is idle.
4. **The instruction line is the assignment.** The same 「pm-dispatch <席位…>」 line written (or rewritten) in a project by the maintainer is the only assignment act; a longer sentence in the project chat (「本账户坐 X；Y 的 PR 由本账户复审」) is an equivalent form. On every coordinator start the line is compared with the seat posts; the coordinator seats or takes over each named seat per `seat-post-protocol.md`, writes the account into the 🟢 line, opens one seat thread per seat, and on first use creates the project's routines (patrol every 2–4 h; a 总监席 adds the daily digest and the hourly inbox scan; a 分诊席 adds the hourly bare-card run). ⛔ No roster file.
5. **Takeover never waits for a walled account.** When the 🟢 line names another account, the instruction line is the 维护者强制接管令 and covers in-flight cards: cross-account `Release:` naming the old session with its 出处, `Resume-from: BRANCH@SHA`, new dev continues the old branch. Ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` + `head:claude/` PRs, read with `assignee:<old login>`; ⛔ never project memory.
6. **Mailbox PR.** PR-bound talk needs nothing new (card threads subscribe their own PRs). For non-PR talk each project may open one draft PR labelled `pm:mailbox` on branch `mailbox/<login>`, subscribed by a resident thread, never merged, closed on handover; first body line `To: <login>`; a `pm:mailbox` PR owes no CI and is excluded from every landing ledger query (the exclusion itself is a devx S card filed in the same stroke).
7. **Roster board.** A pinned objectstack issue 「车队总表」 whose body is regenerated by the 总监席's digest and by whoever seats/takes over/hands over, one row per seat (repo · lane · seat · account · in-flight · awaiting ruling · awaiting landing · wall note · last activity · mailbox PR), read from seat posts, labels, assignees and PR queries. A generated view, ⛔ never hand-edited (rule 5). The generator script is a devx S card filed in the same stroke.
8. **Concurrency** is a per-project posture the maintainer sets in that project (today 6 card threads for this project); ⛔ not a protocol constant.

Edits elsewhere, one line each: `seat-post-protocol.md` (the 🟢 line is the assignment; takeover on the maintainer's sentence), `seat-lifecycle.md` (the project forms do not use the self-bound cron or the cross-wall timer chain), `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 (orders in the thread's opening message, per #25379), `lanes/director.md` (the 总监席 is a seat summoned in any project; see the sibling card for the triage text), `rest-channel.md` (GitHub org Project →「看板」 if #25379 left it).

Out of scope here: the review/landing rule, triage duties and the decision inbox (sibling skills card filed in the same stroke); scripts (three devx cards).

## Acceptance

- `references/project-forms.md` exists, ≤ 60 lines, with a ceiling row; SKILL.md's reference table names it (SKILL.md is at 319/319, so one line is paid by one deleted line).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-frame-freshness` green; new lines paid by deleting Routine-seat-only lines made conditional.
- The reference names no login as an assignment; `git grep -n 'os-bill\|hotlong\|os-elon-musk' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md` returns nothing.
- Tier S landing: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS by a session of another account (the rule the sibling card writes; until it lands, the maintainer's own 「#N 可以落地」 in the seat thread), then the owning seat lands.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "pm-dispatch project forms director project lane project account rotation seat post assignment mailbox PR roster board" → 52 hits; top ten: #25379 (open at search time, PR #25385 landed — the stub this card builds on), #25219 (open, PR #25255 coordinator reference — this card supersedes its lane list by reading seat posts), #23827, #6025, #24145, #21118, #22648, #19287, #20966 (seat posts), #20063 (closed, PR assignee rule). None defines the project layer, the assignment sentence, takeover-without-waiting, mailbox PRs or a generated roster. **New.**

Dedupe words: `project-forms.md` · `pm-dispatch <席位> instruction line` · `assignment sentence 本账户坐` · `mailbox PR pm:mailbox` · `车队总表 roster board`.
